subject: OrbitBridge renewal — hosted API commit uplift and tier adjustments
messages:
From: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@orbitbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@orbitbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 renewal & throughput bump — hosted API

Hi Karthik,

We’re coming up on OrbitBridge’s annual renewal (Dec 1). Usage has grown faster than anticipated — peak month in Q3 consumed ~3.4x our committed tokens and we had to rely on bursts. DevOps asked if we can lock a higher monthly commit and adjust rate limits so our pipelines don’t get soft-throttled during peak windows.

High-level asks:
- Increase hosted monthly commit from 2M tokens -> 6M tokens (target).
- Raise per-second rate for our primary route (ingest->generate) from 120 TPS to 240 TPS or equivalent soft-throttle band.
- Clarify billing/proration if we move the effective date earlier than Dec 1.

I attached our updated MAP (mutual action plan) with expected traffic patterns and a short Ops note. Can Redwood provide an uplift proposal + revised amendment we can route internally? We’re prepared to discuss a 12–18 month term for predictability.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call this week if helpful.

—Ayesha
Ayesha Rahman
Head of Platform | OrbitBridge
Attachment: OB-MAP-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 58KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@orbitbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal & throughput bump — hosted API

Ayesha — thanks for the detailed MAP, that helps. High level we can support the uplift you described. Summary of what I’m proposing for OrbitBridge:

1) Commit uplift: move monthly hosted commit to 6,000,000 tokens; 12-month term.
2) Rate band: increase nominal route qps to 240 TPS; introduce a soft-throttle grace band at 260 TPS for 30-day ramping during launch.
3) Burst: preserve existing burst capability for short spikes up to 3x baseline for emergency runs.
4) Pricing: blended per-token rate for committed volume with a 15% uplift on overage rate vs current plan (we’ll include a stepped overage cap).
5) Effective date options: sign by Nov 15 for Dec 1 start, or we can backdate to Nov 1 with pro-rata billing.

I attached a draft amendment (redwood-draft-amendment.pdf) and updated MAP comments. If this looks close, Marissa will drive the onboarding checklist and we’ll coordinate a cutover window with your DevOps team.

Proposed next steps:
- You approve the terms above or propose tweaks (call optional).
- We send fully redlined amendment and DocuSign.
- Marissa schedules a technical runbook session w/ your devops for gating and KV-cache warmup.

Thanks — I’m available Wednesday or Thursday next week for a 30-minute run-through.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-draft-amendment.pdf (draft amendment, 24KB), OB-MAP-v3.xlsx (annotated)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: OrbitBridge uplift — ops checklist and cutover notes

Karthik / Ben —

Looping in operational items we’ll need if OrbitBridge signs for 6M commit + rate uplift. Below is a compact checklist I’ll run through with Ayesha once we have a signed amendment.

Pre-cutover (T minus 7 days):
- Confirm model variant pinning (prod uses rwd-open-1.3-fp16); if they want quantized variant we’ll note quality delta.
- Reserve Dedicated pool slots for scheduled nightly batch inference jobs (they requested larger batch reserves 00:00–04:00 PST).
- KV cache priming plan and prefix caching policy for their ingest pipeline.
- Adjust route-level QPS guardrails: set soft-throttle at 240 TPS, hard throttle at 280 TPS, and enable temporary backlog shedding for spikes > 3 minutes.
- Billing note: if we backdate to Nov 1 we need approved PO or signed SOW by Nov 15 for accounting.

Cutover day:
- Runbook owner: Marissa Cole (CS)
- Contact: DevOps lead (Ayesha) and Ben for escalation
- Smoke tests: small sample jobs + warm-up caching windows + latency/SLA verification for first two hours.

Post-cutover (T plus 7 days):
- Review token consumption vs commit and adjust batching suggestions via Redwood Optimize if cost drift >10%.
- Set up weekly latency and cost report for first 30 days.

Attachments referenced: OB-MAP-v3.xlsx (traffic patterns); I’ll draft the final runbook once amendment is signed.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Karthik / Marissa — thanks, the terms look good from our side. OrbitBridge confirms:

- Approve 6,000,000 monthly commit on a 12-month term.
- Accept the nominal 240 TPS route band and soft-throttle grace as described.
- We prefer an effective date of Nov 1 with pro-rata billing; finance will issue a PO for Nov 1–Dec 1 proration by Nov 15.

Next requests: please send the final redlined amendment and DocuSign link. Marissa, can we schedule the technical runbook session for Nov 18 (preferred morning PST)? DevOps will be available then.
